title: Take A Leak
description:
Wishlist Now!Welcome to Toilet Labs, where Human testing is back in fashion!
Kidnapped and trapped in a bizarre lab, navigate through challenging toilet-themed puzzles to reach the ultimate throne. Manoeuvre fans, throw plungers, and even manipulate gravity to conserve pee. Confront the eccentric founder, Mr. Latrine and find the secret rooms and the messages he has left for you. Choose your destiny with two endings – ascend to the coveted porcelain throne, or team up with Mr. Latrine to explosively escape the facility. It is up to you to answer nature's call in this quest for bathroom supremacy.Pee
Pee your way through the labs. The more you get in the toilet the higher your score.Solve Toilet Themed Puzzles
Find the solutions to 20 hand crafted puzzles.Interact with the Environment
Use buckets, plungers, fans, gravity and more to solve each level.Uncover the Truth
Explore the secret areas and collect all the Golden Plungers to find out why you are here and how to escape.Multiple Endings
Confront the final lab in an epic conclusion to determine your fate.Wishlist Now!
Approx. 1-2 hours of playtime. I have not tested PlayStation controllers, they may or may not work.
description_short: Navigate toilet puzzles, conserve pee, and follow the eccentric Mr. Latrine in Take a Leak. Choose to ascend to the Toilet Realm or explosively escape the facility. Your bladder, your choice!
